messages:
jess: Heads-up — we saw a p99 latency spike on prod around 2026-03-16T11:02Z. p50 fine, p99 jumped ~3-5x for ~4 minutes. Traces point at long-context requests that also perform repetitive tool-calls. Dumping summary below.

profiling-bot: auto-trace attached (trace_id=tr-9a8b). top spans: model_infer -> attention_kernels -> kv_cache_lookup -> batch_wait.

sara: yikes. any quick mitigation we can flip? revert canary? :grimacing:

jess: Not a rollout issue. Pattern: requests with prompt_len > 2048 + repeated tool_call tokens. Two things collude: (1) kernel-selection picks the slower fallback attn kernel when kv segments > 1024 (seen on these long contexts), (2) our batching heuristic grouped a very long request into a microbatch with others and that single long request caused head-of-line blocking. Also KV miss rate spikes for these traces.

omar: do you have the profile snippet? which kernels and times?

jess: here's a minimal profiling extract from one trace:
```
trace_id: tr-9a8b
seq_len: 2760
model: open-vendor/gpt-like-v1
kernels:
  gpt_attn_opt_v2: 12ms (fast path)
  attn_fallback_v1: 218ms (invoked when kv_segments>1024)
  kv_lookup: 9ms
  kv_serialize: 30ms (hot)
kv_miss_rate: 38% for the prefix region
batch_wait_time: 120ms (one huge request blocked others)
```

liam: that kv_serialize jump is suspicious. we saw something similar last week but dropped it as a client-side pattern.

jess: root causes we think: 1) long prompts push model into fallback kernels + larger memory ops, 2) tool-calling loops cause repeated short/long exchanges that keep extending the sequence, 3) microbatching current heuristic only groups by arrival/time window, not token budget or prefix similarity => big token budgets collide.

omar: Proposed short-to-medium term fixes:
- kernel-selection tweak: check seq_len and kv_segments early and prefer partitioned fast-kernel where possible
- prefix-bucketing: detect similar prefixes / kv-key fingerprints and avoid co-batching mismatched prefixes (reduces kv_miss_rate)
- microbatch token cap: max_tokens_per_batch=4096 (dispatch early if exceeded)
- tool-call circuit-breaker: cap call depth or repeated call loops (max_call_depth=3)

jess: I can land prefix-bucketing + metric for kv_miss_rate (canary first). Omar, can you take kernel-selection changes?

liam: I'll add a routing policy: any request with tool_call metadata goes to a low-latency queue with smaller batch sizes (configurable) so it doesn't block CPU-heavy batches.

sara: oncall: I'll add a temporary p99 alert: if p99 > 800ms for 2m trigger and attach a tag for long-context traces. also add a dashboard row for kv_miss_rate by prefix_bucket.

profiling-bot: quick canary after prefix-bucketing on us-west-2 reduced attn_fallback_v1 invocations by ~80% for traced requests. p99 dropped ~28% in canary traffic slice.

omar: microbatch token-cap perf test: enabling max_tokens_per_batch=4096 reduced p99 by ~30% but increased compute cost ~6% (more smaller batches). tradeoff seems acceptable for user-facing SLOs.

jess: outcome + action items:
- jess -> PR: prefix-bucketing (#5123) (canary 5% traffic)
- omar -> PR: kernel-selection heuristic + unit tests
- liam -> temp route rule for tool_call traffic + adjust batch_size
- sara -> alert/dash updates + monitor playbook
Recheck in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
